content.title: How to watch Diamondbacks vs. Dodgers: TV channel and streaming options for March 26
content.text: The Arizona Diamondbacks will face the Los Angeles Dodgers in the first game of the season on Thursday. The game starts at 8:30 p.m. ET, at Dodger Stadium. Yoshinobu Yamamoto gets the start for the Dodgers, and Zac Gallen is expected to start for the Diamondbacks.How to watch Arizona Diamondbacks vs. Los Angeles Dodgers Venue: Dodger Stadium Time: 8:30 p.m. ET TV: NBC/Peacock Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub.
